title: Credit Note: Credit Use and the Late-Fee Rate on Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements Invoices
content:
Credit and Collections measures how much of its credit limit a Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements agreement is using, and the measure raises the late-fee rate charged on an overdue invoice.

**Credit use.** The agreement's open invoice balance is read from its invoice entries as every invoice charge, whether or not it is yet due, plus every late fee, less every payment, held to the cent. Its credit use is that balance divided by the tier's credit limit.

**Effect on the late-fee rate.** Credit use raises the late-fee rate:

| Credit use | Rise in the late-fee rate |
|---|---|
| at or above 0.9 | 0.5 percentage points |
| at or above 0.6 and below 0.9 | 0.25 percentage points |
| below 0.6 | no rise |

The rise is added, in percentage points, to the late-fee rate itself, before the rate is applied to the unpaid amount past due.

### Credit limits and the balances at which the rate rises

| Tier | Credit limit (USD) | Balance for a rise of 0.25 points (USD, at or above) | Balance for a rise of 0.5 points (USD, at or above) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Business Connect | 0 (no invoice billing) | — | — |
| Crestline Business Connect Plus | 0 (no invoice billing) | — | — |
| Crestline Corporate Select | 50000 | 30000 | 45000 |
| Crestline Corporate Preferred | 150000 | 90000 | 135000 |
| Crestline Corporate Premier | 500000 | 300000 | 450000 |
| Crestline Corporate Strategic | 2000000 | 1200000 | 1800000 |

### Cases (hypothetical balances)

- A Crestline Corporate Select agreement with an open invoice balance of USD 45000.00 has a credit use of exactly 0.9; its late-fee rate rises by 0.5 percentage points.
- The same agreement at USD 44999.99 is below 0.9 and at or above 0.6; the rate rises by 0.25 percentage points.
- A Crestline Corporate Premier agreement with a balance of USD 250000.00 has a credit use of 0.5; the rate does not rise.
- A charge not yet due still counts in the open invoice balance: charges of USD 30000.00 and 20000.00, one of them not yet due, a late fee of USD 100.00 and payments of USD 12000.00 give a balance of USD 38100.00.
